title: OpenQuest
reason: OpenQuest has strong first-party reuse and redistribution evidence and an author-controlled CC-BY-4.0 repository/release, but the pinned v1.0 license record identifies a bundled third-party Verb Bar with no formal license. A surviving author discussion offers MIT relicensing if needed, but Abandonware does not treat an offer as an executed redistribution license. Production stays fail-closed while source and creator-release identity audits continue.
